ProgramUnit.Name: SELECT_CUST_WITH_CONTRACT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure select_cust_with_contract
 (entry in VARCHAR2, include in VARCHAR2, cust_id out VARCHAR2) is
 --
 -- this procedure allows user to select customer by entering a few
 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search
 -- include : customer_types to be included
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 inlist VARCHAR2(100);
 chap_id varchar2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 cursor c1 is select code
 from vserv_customer_type where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) 
 union 
 select code
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'DCUST' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) 
 order by 1;
begin
 --
 -- set up list of customer types to be included
 if include is null
 then
 for c1rec in c1
 loop
 inlist :=inlist||c1rec.code||',';
 --next_record; -- Change made by Kishore on 05/22/09
 end loop;
 inlist :=''''||rtrim(inlist,',')||'''';
 -- inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,PA,RD,RG'; -- all customer types
 else
 inlist := include;
 end if;
 --
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = entry
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where upper(name) like entry || '%'
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 -- cust_id := '';
 list_values;
 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers, Contracts');
 check_package_failure;
end;
